title: Listen and choose 3.1
role: Local guide suggesting sights and giving advice to visitors
can_do: I can suggest sights and give advice to visitors.
I can explain rules and limits that protect a place, using the passive.

items.prompt: What are visitors expected to do?
items.explanation: Visitors are expected to keep a distance.

items.prompt: Why is the cave closed on rainy days?
items.explanation: The entrance floods and the path becomes dangerous.

items.prompt: What is the advantage of leaving early?

options.text: The place will be nearly empty

items.explanation: If you leave by five, you will have the place almost to yourselves.
